company.name: Humanloop
company.shortDescription: Humanloop is an AI platform that helps enterprises evaluate, manage, and monitor large language model applications.
company.description: Humanloop develops an AI platform designed to support enterprises in building and maintaining applications powered by large language models. The platform provides tools for prompt management, evaluation, and observability, enabling teams to test, monitor, and improve AI system performance. Humanloop supports collaboration between engineers, product teams, and domain experts to refine AI outputs and ensure reliability. Its tools are used to manage workflows around AI development, helping organizations deploy and optimize AI features with structured evaluation processes.
